name: Leg Press Machine

instructions.description: Sit in the machine with back and hips supported.
Place both feet flat on the platform.
Press the platform away until the knees are comfortably extended.
Return slowly to a controlled depth.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the external load used without treating it as a universal target.
Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Leg Press Machine — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Leg Press Machine — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Use a comfortable depth and keep feet fully supported.
